newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: EU "liaising actively" with NATO on Albania.
newsitem.headline: EU "liaising actively" with NATO on Albania.

text.p: The European Union said on Friday it was working closely with the Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe (OSCE) and NATO on a coordinated response to the crisis in Albania.

"The Union is coordinating closely with the OSCE and will liaise actively with NATO and other organisations, so that appropriate action can be taken urgently," the EU said in a statement released by the Dutch presidency.
"The European Union expresses grave concern at the breakdown of civil order in Albania," the statement said.

"It calls upon the government, political forces and other groups throughout the country to refrain from violence and to work for the restoration of order and a return to a proper democratic process, which is the only way to overcome the present crisis," it added.

The European Union reiterated its support for OSCE mediator Franz Vranitzky who planned to meet Albanian government ministers on Friday as part of international efforts to halt more than a month of political violence.
Albania's beleaguered government called for foreign military intervention on Thursday to halt spreading disorder as the United States and European nations evacuated nationals from the Balkan state.
